weights.cpu_runtime: llama.cpp b12441; derived Q4_1 copy of the same target weights

protocol.fresh_game: Eight distinct six-second windows across two Wuthering Waves gameplay recordings, six production frames, 1024x960 JPEG fixed by SHA-256. The high-detail prompt uses the same 160-token limit and includes format recovery.
protocol.recall: Another eight clips, two new questions on each image. One worker resident per run in A/B/B/A order. One excluded warm-up per worker. Each version sees the same inputs, questions and output limits.
protocol.render: 1280x720 offscreen Metal rendering, 60Hz target, 1450 shader iterations. GPU device utilization sampled every 0.5s. Render times are simulator service times. NSProcessInfo thermal state 0 is nominal. Darwin memory-pressure level 1 is normal.
protocol.statistics: Wall clock through the whole final answer. p50 is the median, p95 nearest rank. Repeated measurements on the same eight windows are paired but are not additional independent clips.
protocol.native: Production capture, selection, parsing, voice eligibility; recorded frame provider and test speech transport. No live game client or speaker measurements.
protocol.close_pairs: One worker resident. Four groups of two six-frame clips each, one excluded warm-up per launch. Versions alternate in adjacent launches, reversing order on the second pass. The screen label steady-original-submit matches all six shipped vision Python modules byte for byte.
protocol.continuous_workers: Continuous fresh gameplay was measured both with separately initialized workers resident in the same run (alternating each image and reversing order in another run), and with only one instance resident at a time (original/previous/current/current/previous/original startup order, eight windows each). All requests are sequential.
protocol.idle_renderer: Separate 15-second Metal run at identical resolution, shader settings and frame-rate target, without an inference worker. First second excluded.
protocol.comparison: Original and previous release are independently timed. Only paired intervals with identical fixed input bytes and prompts are compared for long-answer speed. Product-selected inputs and audio requests are reported separately.

checks.mypy: Success: no issues found in 234 source files
checks.input: Pixel tensors and image grids matched for four RGB images, including resize and retry.
checks.packaged: Packaged source contains the visual worker modules, with contents verified.

answer_text_by_sha256.ecf2a5f6354ded1a7626da7a1dab868db6724893: 从第一帧到最后一帧，角色和镜头环境发生了显著变化：首先，第一帧中角色处于草地边缘的开阔区域，背景是模糊的建筑轮廓；而最后一帧则显示在一条道路上，周围有玩家操控的角色（如蓝色武器）与敌人进行激烈战斗。同时，第二、三帧中出现大量火焰特效，说明场景可能经历了激烈的火场或爆炸事件。镜头方面，第一帧为固定视角观察角色与环境，而后续几帧中镜头角度有所变化，以适应不同战斗状态下的视觉呈现。
